parsed.attack: There is nothing to share: the artifact is a list of three friends you have been neglecting plus your own free calendar gaps, which is about the most private object the phone can assemble - nobody screenshots it, posts it, or forwards it. The friend you then call receives a phone call: full value, no install, no awareness the app exists. So the shareable-artifact loop reduces to asking the single most time-starved cohort alive, parents of under-fives, to perform unpaid marketing during the eighteen months when they have no discretionary minutes, and the brief itself fires once a day on a cycle no faster than the user's own guilt.
parsed.strongest_defence: The artifact was never the channel: expat-parent Facebook groups and r/expats are dense, free and full of the 'I only ever remember at 2am their time' complaint posted weekly, and a single honest reply in those threads converts people who are already describing the exact pain.
parsed.verdict_reason: The claimed shareable-artifact loop cannot turn because the artifact is unpostable and the recipient needs no software, though a free hand-worked forum channel remains.
